Eglantine 
 
 

 Eglantine is a free and opensource (FOSS) Switch 2 emulator, derived from Eden, Yuzu and Sudachi - started by developer Camille LaVey.
It's written in C++ with portability in mind, with builds for Windows, Linux and macOS
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Compatibility 
 Development 
 Building 
 Download 
 Support 
 License 
 

 Compatibility

The emulator is capable of running Mario Kart World at full speed on most specs, Splatoon Raiders and OOT also run fine.

A list of supported games will be available in future. Please be patient.

 Development

For development discussions, please join us on Discord

If you would like to contribute, we are open to new developers and pull requests. Please ensure that your work is of a high standard and properly documented. You can also contact any of the developers on Discord or Stoat to learn more about the current state of the emulator.

 Documentation

We have a user manual! See our User Handbook.

 Building

See the General Build Guide

For information on provided development tooling, see the Tools directory

 Download

You can download the latest releases from here.

 Support

We currently do not take in any donations for the time being

If you would prefer to support us in a different way, please join our Discord

 Star History

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 License

Eglantine is licensed under the GPLv3 (or any later version). Refer to the LICENSE.txt file.
